en: Black‑and‑white postcard image showing a massive brick city gate or fortification portal with a central arched entrance closed by heavy wooden doors, flanked by two smaller arched openings. Above the main arch is a sculpted coat of arms with an eagle, and higher up a relief with a shield supported by two lions plus two niches with standing figures. Small street signs are mounted on the façade, and there are cobblestone streets, trees on the left, and old multi‑storey townhouses on the right.
